book.title: Blue Ocean Strategy
book.author: W. Chan Kim and Renee Mauborgne

predict.question: B has equally likely net outcomes 10 and 0. What is B’s toy result?

exploreHint: Run both cases; compare the changed input.
bookIdea: Blue Ocean Strategy considers changing which factors a business offers rather than competing only by adding more.
modelBoundary: A averages {A}; B averages {B}. The redesign gives up ten points in the favorable branch and recovers twenty in the unfavorable branch. Net values are invented; no buyer response, new market or innovation effect is established.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? The arithmetic follows our assumptions; real-world applicability and book attribution remain unverified.
